gameDescriptionHtml:
A definitive edition of the “Secret” series, “Atelier Ryza: Secret Trilogy DX,” complete with new stories, playable characters, and features.

This set features all three Secret series DX titles for a discounted price:

  • Atelier Ryza: Ever Darkness & the Secret Hideout DX
  • Atelier Ryza 2: Lost Legends & the Secret Fairy DX
  • Atelier Ryza 3: Alchemist of the End & the Secret Key DX

Ryza 1:
This edition includes new stories, playable characters, and features that have been added to “Atelier Ryza: Ever Darkness & the Secret Hideout.”
This game depicts the coming-of-age story of an ordinary girl named Ryza and her friends as they come in contact with alchemy and set out on a grand adventure involving the secrets of the island they call home.

Ryza 2:
This edition includes new stories, playable characters, and features that have been added to “Atelier Ryza 2: Lost Legends & the Secret Fairy.”
Set three years after “Atelier Ryza,” this game tells the story of matured Ryza and her friends as they reunite and have new encounters, all leading into an important decision. The story of summer and youths begins anew.

Ryza 3:
This edition includes new stories, playable characters, and features that have been added to “Atelier Ryza 3: Alchemist of the End & the Secret Key.”
Set one year after “Atelier Ryza 2,” this game follows the final summer adventure of Ryza and her friends as they learn about the origins of alchemy and discover the mysteries of their world.

Game Features

  • (Ryza 1) Three new playable characters – Agatha, Kilo, and Romy are now available as playable characters.
  • (Ryza 1) A new story featuring Kilo and Bos – This side story follows Bos as he is chased into the Underworld and meets Kilo before reuniting with Ryza. You can also explore as Kilo!
  • (Ryza 1) A new after story – This story features Ryza, Agatha, and Romy and takes place between the events of Ryza 1 and Ryza 2. Having remained on the island, Ryza now teaches the local children as a substitute teacher and must search for them when they sneak out on an adventure.
  • (Ryza 2) Two new playable characters – Empel and Lila are now available as playable characters.
  • (Ryza 2) A new story featuring Empel and Lila – This side story follows Empel and Lila as they search for a gate to the Underworld before they reunite with Ryza. Control Lila as you explore both familiar areas and a new map!
  • (Ryza 2) Fi will help you on your adventure – Fi will follow Ryza as she moves around the field, providing support. Fi expands the range of the sensor map, restores HP after combat, and helps out in other ways too!
  • (Ryza 3) Three new playable characters – Clifford, Serri, and Kilo are now available as playable characters.
  • (Ryza 3) A new story featuring Clifford and Serri – After parting ways with Ryza, Clifford and Serri meet again on a deserted island and team up to pursue their goals. Control Serri as you explore both familiar areas and a new map!
  • (Ryza 3) Added a Wind Beast which automatically gathers ingredients to assist your exploration!
  • (COMMON) A Custom Combat mode – Select monsters to face and set their levels. You can also change monster behavior, the speed of battle, and other settings.
  • (COMMON) All additional content from the original game – Includes both free and paid content, such as swimsuit outfits, additional maps and recipes, and more!
  • (COMMON) Improved in-game functions and usability – Increased basket and container capacity; Additional graphic options; Improved UI/UX; Improved Spirit Beast functions.
  • (COMMON) Link save data from “Secret” series games for bonuses! – You can link to both the original and DX versions, allowing you to obtain useful items for your adventure. Note: “Ryza 1 DX,” “Ryza 2 DX,” and “Ryza 3 DX” all feature different save data requirements and bonuses.
